# CCM Talent

> CCM Talent is a talent management agency for lifestyle creators. It also helps brands work with those creators. Co-founded by Ismail Nur and Nabeel Ahmed. Contact: ismail@conticonnects.com

## Pages
- [Talent management for lifestyle creators, and the brands that work with them](https://www.conticonnects.com/): Talent management for lifestyle creators. We pitch, negotiate and manage brand deals, and help brands work with creators.
- [Influencer talent management](https://www.conticonnects.com/talent-management/): What influencer talent management covers at CCM Talent: brand pitching, rates, contracts, usage rights, deadlines and payment follow-up.
- [Apply for creator management](https://www.conticonnects.com/apply/): Apply for talent management as a lifestyle creator. Send your main channel, your niche and the brands you want.
- [Work with creators](https://www.conticonnects.com/brands/): Brands: work with lifestyle creators through one contact. Creator suggestions, availability, terms and posting dates.
- [Creators for brands](https://www.conticonnects.com/creators/): Brands can request lifestyle creators from CCM Talent. Email us your product and we reply with creators who fit.
- [About us](https://www.conticonnects.com/about/): CCM Talent is a new talent management agency for lifestyle creators, co-founded by Ismail Nur and Nabeel Ahmed.
- [Influencer management FAQ](https://www.conticonnects.com/faq/): Plain answers about influencer talent management: followers, exclusivity, usage rights, gifted products, agencies and how brands work with us.
- [Contact](https://www.conticonnects.com/contact/): Contact CCM Talent about talent management or working with lifestyle creators. Email us or follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
- [Guides for creators](https://www.conticonnects.com/guides/): Guides for creators on managers, followers, agencies, contracts and brand deals, written by CCM Talent.
- [What does an influencer manager do?](https://www.conticonnects.com/guides/what-does-an-influencer-manager-do/): An influencer manager pitches brands, negotiates rates and contracts, manages deadlines and follows up payment. What stays with the creator.
- [How many followers do you need to get a manager?](https://www.conticonnects.com/guides/how-many-followers-to-get-a-manager/): There is no set follower count to get an influencer manager. What managers look at instead: niche, engagement, posting and brand fit.
- [Talent manager vs influencer marketing agency](https://www.conticonnects.com/guides/talent-manager-vs-influencer-marketing-agency/): A talent manager works for the creator. An influencer marketing agency works for the brand. See who pays whom and which one you need.
- [Sponsored content policy](https://www.conticonnects.com/disclosure/): How CCM Talent handles ad disclosure for paid posts, gifted products and hosted stays, following FTC guidance.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.conticonnects.com/privacy/): What information CCM Talent collects through this website, how it is used, and how to have it deleted.
- [Website terms](https://www.conticonnects.com/terms/): The terms for using the CCM Talent website.
